hypothesis: The UB overrun comes only from the tile element budget (8192 elements for the target case), because the two int64 3D offset tensors alone cost 16 B/elem and the fp32 q opmath adds more. Halving the element budget to 4096 keeps every empirical B/elem term identical and should drop the requirement to ~139 KiB, below the 192 KiB UB, while still allowing BLOCK_H=4 head grouping to be retained so the strided input rows stay BLOCK_H*head_dim contiguous.
